title: Design System: Dr. Maycon Gomes — Odontologia

display.purpose: The hero headline only. One per page, never reused for a section.

headline.purpose: Every section h2. Must be the largest element in its section.

title.purpose: Card and step titles (h3). Carries Sora at reduced size.

body.purpose: All readable text. Measure capped at 62ch for leads, 68ch for fine print.

lead.purpose: The single argument-carrying paragraph per section.

label.purpose: Eyebrow above each headline, uppercase with a 26x2px gradient bar before it.

fine-print.purpose: Disclaimers and secondary facts. Lowest contrast tier on its ground.

shadows.name: xs
shadows.purpose: Hairline lift for the smallest raised elements.

shadows.name: sm
shadows.purpose: Resting lift for cards. The default card shadow.

shadows.name: md
shadows.purpose: Hovered cards and the mobile nav overlay.

shadows.name: lg
shadows.purpose: Lightbox and other full-screen layers only.

shadows.name: teal
shadows.purpose: Primary button at rest. Expands to 0 18px 42px rgba(20,214,196,0.4) on hover.

shadows.name: white-deep
shadows.purpose: White button on dark grounds, where a navy shadow would disappear.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Every state transition in the system. The single easing curve.

motion.name: dur-state
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and press transitions on controls.

motion.name: dur-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal entry, staggered 90ms per data-delay step.

motion.name: dur-sweep
motion.purpose: The specular gradient sweep across a button face on hover.

motion.name: dur-marquee
motion.purpose: Testimonial marquee speed, held constant at 60 px/s across widths.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action of the page. Opens the chat with an evaluation request.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.7rem; font-family: var(--font-display, "Sora", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.97rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; color: #04202b; background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--teal-500, #14d6c4), var(--teal-600, #0fbba9) 55%, var(--blue-500, #2e7be8) 130%); border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(20, 214, 196, 0.32); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 -60%; width: 45%; background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.35), transparent); transform: skewX(-18deg); transition: left 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); z-index: -1; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(20, 214, 196, 0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after { left: 120%; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--teal-500, #14d6c4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Button Large
components.description: Hero and closing CTA scale. Same construction, larger optical weight.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-lg { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 1.05rem 2.1rem; font-family: var(--font-display, "Sora", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1.02rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; color: #04202b; background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--teal-500, #14d6c4), var(--teal-600, #0fbba9) 55%, var(--blue-500, #2e7be8) 130%); border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(20, 214, 196, 0.32); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary-lg:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(20, 214, 196, 0.4); } .ds-btn-primary-lg:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--teal-500, #14d6c4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Light Button
components.description: Inverted action for dark grounds, including the closing CTA panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-light { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.7rem; font-family: var(--font-display, "Sora", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.97rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--navy-900, #071b33); background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(4, 16, 31, 0.35); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-light:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 22px 52px rgba(4, 16, 31, 0.45); } .ds-btn-light:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--teal-400, #3ee6d6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action on dark grounds where a solid button would dominate.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.7rem; font-family: var(--font-display, "Sora", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.97rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; color: #fff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34); border-radius: 999px; backdrop-filter: blur(6px); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--teal-400, #3ee6d6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Tertiary action on light grounds. Inverts to solid navy on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.7rem; font-family: var(--font-display, "Sora", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.97rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--navy-800, #0a2540); background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid rgba(7, 27, 51, 0.16); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--navy-800, #0a2540); border-color: var(--navy-800, #0a2540); color: #fff; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--teal-500, #14d6c4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Treatment category filter. The selected state is a full primary button.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.6rem 1.15rem; font-family: var(--font-display, "Sora", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--navy-800, #0a2540); background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(7, 27, 51, 0.16); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--teal-500, #14d6c4); color: var(--teal-600, #0fbba9); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--teal-500, #14d6c4); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-chip.is-selected { color: #04202b; background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--teal-500, #14d6c4), var(--teal-600, #0fbba9) 55%, var(--blue-500, #2e7be8) 130%); border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(20, 214, 196, 0.32); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation item. No underline at rest; teal on hover and when active.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-block; padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem; font-family: var(--font-body, "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--navy-800, #0a2540); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 12px; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--teal-600, #0fbba9); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--teal-500, #14d6c4); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: var(--teal-600, #0fbba9); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Treatment card. Flat at rest, lifted on hover. Carries a stroked icon tile.
components.html:
Aparelhos ortopédicos

Guiam a posição dos dentes e o desenvolvimento da mordida.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1.75rem; background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(7, 27, 51, 0.09); border-radius: 26px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(7, 27, 51, 0.08); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(7, 27, 51, 0.11); } .ds-card-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 46px; height: 46px; color: var(--teal-500, #14d6c4); background: var(--surface-soft, #eef4f9); border-radius: 14px; } .ds-card-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display, "Sora", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: clamp(1.12rem, 1.7vw, 1.3rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.16; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--ink-900, #0b1b2b); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-body, "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--ink-600, #44566b); }

components.name: Testimonial Card
components.description: Patient quote on a dark ground. Uses a monogram avatar, never a photo.
components.css: .ds-dep { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; margin: 0; padding: 2rem; color: var(--on-dark-soft, #b9c9d9); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); border-radius: 26px; } .ds-dep-stars { color: var(--teal-400, #3ee6d6); font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .ds-dep blockquote { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-body, "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--on-dark, #eaf2f8); } .ds-dep figcaption { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.85rem; margin-top: auto; } .ds-dep-avatar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; font-family: var(--font-display, "Sora", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy-900, #071b33); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-400, #3ee6d6), var(--blue-500, #2e7be8)); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-dep figcaption strong { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display, "Sora", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; } .ds-dep figcaption span { font-family: var(--font-body, "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.83rem; color: var(--on-dark-mute, #8ba2b8); }

narrative.overview:
A landing page for a single orthodontist is not a catalogue. It is an instrument panel with one gauge: is this the person I trust with my teeth? The whole system is built to answer that quietly. Precision is expressed through restraint — a tight type scale, a closed radius scale, a two-colour accent that never runs away, shadows that exist to state hierarchy and nothing more. Care is expressed through warmth of the surface: off-white and near-white backgrounds instead of pure white, a deep navy that reads as calm night rather than corporate black, and rounded forms that read as handled, not machined.

The North Star is deliberately not clinical-cold and not lifestyle-warm. "Precisão que Cuida" occupies the exact middle a nervous patient is looking for: this person measures everything, and nothing about the measuring is intimidating. Every visual decision should be defensible in those two terms — does it communicate exactness, does it lower the pulse. If a change does neither, it is decoration and does not ship.

The system is a single world, not a family of page themes. Sections alternate light and quiet-light planes, with three deliberate dark departures — hero, testimonials and the closing CTA — all built on the same navy-plus-glow foundation so the page breathes at a consistent cadence instead of jumping between moods.
keyCharacteristics: Two fonts, two jobs: Sora for anything that speaks, Inter for anything that must be read.
One accent (teal) with one partner (blue), used on under a tenth of any screen.
Four radii and one pill. Nothing in between.
Shadows are structural, never ambient decoration.
Corners are generous and consistent; nothing is sharp except the eye of an icon.
Copy sits in calm, wide-leaded blocks; measure never exceeds 62ch.

rules.name: The One Gauge Rule
rules.body: Turquesa Vivo appears on at most one element per viewport — one primary button, one eyebrow, one focus ring. Its rarity is what makes it read as a signal instead of decoration. When a second teal element would compete, the second one goes navy or white.

rules.name: The No Flat Black Rule
rules.body: Pure black and pure grey are banned. The darkest value in the system is #04101f, the lightest neutral is a blue-tinted ink. Every neutral is tinted toward the navy family.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Sora appears only where something is being said — headlines, titles, buttons, eyebrows. Inter appears only where something is being read. Never set Inter at display size to fake a headline, never set Sora at body size to fake emphasis.

rules.name: The Em Gradient Rule
rules.body: The emphasised fragment inside a headline (always one em per headline, never two) is the only place a gradient is applied to text. It is the reading entry point of the section.

rules.name: The Balanced Line Rule
rules.body: Every headline carries text-wrap: balance and every paragraph carries text-wrap: pretty. A headline that breaks on a single trailing word is a bug, not a style.

rules.name: The Meaningful Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow traces to a state or a layer. If you cannot name the state it marks, delete it. In particular: do not put a resting shadow on a flat card purely for decoration.

rules.name: The Halo Rule
rules.body: Only the primary action carries a coloured glow, and only in the accent colour. A second glowing element on the same screen halves the effect of the first.

dos: Do keep exactly one primary action per viewport, and repeat it consistently — the CTA is always "Agendar avaliação", always opening the chat with the evaluation request.
Do let every shadow answer to a named state (hover, raised layer, focus).
Do put exactly one gradient em inside each headline, and keep the word or phrase there short enough to read as emphasis rather than decoration.
Do cap body measure at 62ch and set text-wrap: balance on every headline.
Do keep dark sections to three: hero, testimonials, closing CTA. Their rarity is what makes the navy feel deep.
Do pair every reveal animation with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback that leaves the content visible.
donts: Don't introduce a third accent colour, or move turquesa into a large fill. The One Gauge Rule holds.
Don't add a new radius between 12 and 34px, and never square a corner that the system rounds.
Don't set Sora at body size or Inter at display size — the Two-Voice Rule holds.
Don't put grey text on a coloured ground, or grey text on navy below --on-dark-soft.
Don't add a price, a deadline, a result guarantee or any clinical promise to any surface, including microcopy, alt text, or structured data.
Don't present a testimonial, review score, patient count or outcome statistic that is not verified evidence. The six existing testimonials carry placeholder names and are not proof.
